overview: The Parks Commission reviewed conceptual flood mitigation designs for Tufts Park, approved an expansion of the Tufts Park community garden, and resolved scheduling and permitting requests for spring and summer athletic field use across city parks.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the March meeting minutes.

items.title: Park Permit Revenue Discussion
items.summary: Commissioners briefly discussed park permit revenues and opted to table further review until next month.

items.title: CPA Funding Report
items.summary: Graham presented an overview of recent Community Preservation Act grant allocations across open space, historic preservation, and affordable housing.

items.title: Pickleball Court Reservation Fee
items.summary: The commission voted to set an initial $25 daily fee and restricted signage rules for an upcoming charity pickleball tournament while staff gathers regional benchmark data for future policy.

items.title: Brooks Elementary PTO Pass Donation
items.summary: The commission approved the annual donation of one pond pass and one pool pass to the Brooks Elementary PTO for an upcoming spring event.

items.title: Tufts Park Conceptual Design Presentation
items.summary: Representatives from the Mystic River Watershed Association and Horsley Witten Group presented early conceptual designs to address flooding at Tufts Park through underground storage and field reconfigurations, receiving commissioner feedback on softball field dimensions and park amenities.

items.title: Tufts Park Community Garden Expansion
items.summary: The commission approved the Community Garden Commission's proposal to add 10 new garden beds at Tufts Park, agreeing that future community garden initiatives should consult the Parks Commission prior to applying for CPA funding.

items.title: Field Permit Applications
items.summary: The commission reviewed and acted on several summer field permits, approving requests for ultimate frisbee, school cross country, and adult softball while coordinating around scheduling conflicts at Morrison, Playstead, Tufts, and Barry parks.

items.title: United India Event Request at Columbus Park
items.summary: The commission approved Columbus Park field use for the United India festival while denying a requested bounce house pursuant to city legal guidance.
